schema.text: Do you use the car to pick people up with luggage at a station or airport, especially in the evening?

ar.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: هل تستخدم السيارة من أجل استقبال أشخاص معهم أمتعة في محطة أو مطار، خاصةً في المساء؟

de.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Nutzen Sie das Auto, um Menschen mit Gepäck am Bahnhof oder Flughafen abzuholen, besonders abends?

en.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Do you use the car to pick people up with luggage at a station or airport, especially in the evening?

fa.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: آیا از خودرو استفاده می‌کنید تا افرادی را که چمدان دارند از ایستگاه یا فرودگاه بردارید، به‌ویژه عصر؟

fr.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Utilisez-vous la voiture pour aller chercher des personnes avec des bagages à une gare ou à un aéroport, surtout le soir ?

hu.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Használja az autót csomaggal érkező emberek felvételére az állomáson vagy a repülőtéren, különösen este?

it.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Usi l’auto per andare a prendere persone con i bagagli in stazione o in aeroporto, soprattutto la sera?

tr.#Do you use the car to pick people up wi: Özellikle akşamları, bir istasyondan veya havalimanından bagajlı kişileri almak için arabayı kullanıyor musunuz?
